frozen_note: Frozen 2026-10-18 before pool evaluation and before J2 inference; no weights may be tuned after seeing J2 results. This artifact describes the exact frozen scoring formula in src/hinglish/selection.py (hinglish/labelfree v1) as hashed below.

provenance.note: All weights, saturation constants, band edges, and precedence rules were fixed before any pool evaluation and before any J2 inference. The only evidence consulted was the committed J1 decoder-probe history (results/hinglish/decoder_probe_metrics.json and results/hinglish/decoder_probe_plan.json, pre-registered before its own execution): its three pre-registered control clips define the expected transcription-rate band, and its ceiling/cap-hit findings motivate the cap-hit floors. No J2 (pool) inference had been run, and no pool statistics other than the committed control clips were inspected before freezing.
provenance.hash_scope: sha256 of the final frozen src/hinglish/selection.py file bytes, computed before any J2 run or label-free pool evaluation.
provenance.selection_module_note: If this hash does not match the selection module used at evaluation time, the session contract violation is: the scoring code drifted after pre-registration and cannot be compared against this pre-registration.

scope.oracle_mode_untouched: SelectionConfig(acquisition_mode='oracle') scoring (failure/code_mix/duration/quality with SCORING_WEIGHTS) is unchanged byte-for-byte; nothing in this artifact modifies the supervised oracle formula.
scope.ranking_orientation: The overall label-free score is the weighted mean of the component values; HIGHER overall = a better acquisition candidate (more suspicious/more useful for adaptation), consistent with the existing intelligent-arm convention in which high failure evidence raises rank. duration_fit is the one preference component: high means the duration fits the ~8 s annotation-preferred band.

weights.renormalization: For each candidate, the overall score is (sum of weight_i * value_i over components with value not None) / (sum of weight_i over components with value not None). Components with value None are excluded entirely; they are never zero-filled.

tokenizer_and_inference_semantics.budget_meaning: generated_token_count counts content tokens outside the forced prefix (trailing EOS stripped). Hitting 444 (default) or 160 (C1 config, beyond the 4-token prefix) sets hit_length_limit_effective.

duration_fit.math: reuse duration_component(candidate.duration_sec, config) exactly: None if duration is unknown; span = max(preferred - min_bound, max_bound - preferred); value = max(0, 1 - |duration - preferred| / span). With the default bounds [1, 20] s it is 1.0 at preferred = 8.0 s and decays linearly to 0.0 at the bounds.
duration_fit.inputs: CandidateRecord.duration_sec (pool manifest, seconds); config.min_duration_sec / max_duration_sec / preferred_duration_sec.
duration_fit.None_policy: None when duration is unknown (require_duration=True makes this impossible for eligible pool candidates).

math: if repetition_flag is True: base = max(base, 0.75)
if hit_length_limit_effective is True and eos_emitted_effective is not True: base = max(base, 0.85)
if eos_emitted_effective is True and hit_length_limit_effective is False: base = min(base, 0.55)
repetition_risk.inputs: AsrOutputFeatures.repeated_token_fraction (fraction of output tokens repeating an earlier token ID in the same sequence), max_consecutive_repeated_tokens (longest single-token-run length), repetition_flag (heuristic looping flag), eos_emitted_effective, hit_length_limit_effective.
repetition_risk.None_policy: None unless BOTH repeated_token_fraction AND max_consecutive_repeated_tokens are present. A partial repetition measurement is never scored as a partial sum (missing statistics are never treated as zero repetition).
repetition_risk.flag_and_stop_boolean_policy: repetition_flag=None behaves as not flagged (no floor). The cap-hit floor requires hit_length_limit_effective to be exactly True and eos_emitted_effective to be anything other than True (None or False both trigger it, because an unknown EOS with a capped decode is consistent with truncation looping). The natural-stop clamp requires eos_emitted_effective to be exactly True and hit_length_limit_effective to be exactly False.

math: rate = generated_token_count / candidate.duration_sec (tokens per audio second; duration from the pool manifest, positive by eligibility)
if rate < band_low: anomaly = (band_low - rate) / (band_low - saturation_low)
elif rate > band_high: anomaly = (rate - band_high) / (saturation_high - band_high)
if hit_length_limit_effective is True and eos_emitted_effective is not True: anomaly = max(anomaly, 0.80)

healthy_token_rate_band.derivation: tokens per audio second at probe config C0 over the three pre-registered control clips in results/hinglish/decoder_probe_metrics.json (per_clip records, category 'control', resolved per decoder_probe_plan.json selection rule R3 by clip-ID prefixes 111627_ / 136706_ / 415128_). C0 = pinned default decoding (max_length 448 -> 444 content tokens; every control ended naturally by EOS).
healthy_token_rate_band.band_rule: min/max/mean of the three control rates; min and max are the band edges.
healthy_token_rate_band.metric_consistency_requirement: J2 must compute generated_token_count with the same definition as the committed J1 C0 records (content tokens, trailing EOS stripped).

saturation_constants.saturation_low_definition: 0.5 x band_low (rate 50% below the healthy low edge -> 1.0)
saturation_constants.saturation_high_definition: 1.5 x band_high (rate 50% above the healthy high edge -> 1.0)

cap_override.rule: hit_length_limit_effective is True and eos_emitted_effective is not True -> anomaly = max(anomaly, 0.80). It never lowers a larger computed anomaly.

length_anomaly.None_policy: None when generated_token_count is None or the manifest duration is None. A non-positive duration raises ValueError (cannot define a rate); eligibility in this mode guarantees a known positive duration.

confidence_risk.inputs: AsrOutputFeatures.mean_logprob and min_logprob (chosen-token logprobs per step, sequence-level mean and minimum).
confidence_risk.None_policy: None when either measured logprob is None. Both are required (a probability record with one missing channel is not scored as a partial sum).

math: clip_risk = clamp01(clipping_fraction / 0.05) if clipping_fraction is not None else None
if clip_risk is not None and peak_dbfs is not None and peak_dbfs >= -0.5: clip_risk = max(clip_risk, 0.70)
if clip_risk is None and peak_dbfs is not None and peak_dbfs >= -0.5: clip_risk = 0.70  # peak floor stands alone
rms_risk = clamp01((abs(mean_rms_dbfs) - 38.0) / 20.0) if mean_rms_dbfs is not None else None  # |rms| <= 38 dBFS -> 0; >= 58 -> 1
result = arithmetic mean of the available risks (equal 0.5/0.5 subweights renormalized over what is available)
audio_quality_risk.inputs: Pool-manifest audio metadata carried on CandidateRecord: audio_peak_dbfs (dBFS, negative; 0.0 = full scale), audio_clipping_fraction (in [0, 1]), audio_mean_rms_dbfs (dBFS). These are optional manifest fields, not inference outputs.
audio_quality_risk.None_policy: None only when ALL three inputs are None. With some inputs present, the available risks are renormalized (a missing clipping fraction is the one case that cannot create a partial base; a peak >= -0.5 dBFS alone still yields the 0.70 floor). A single available risk renormalizes to full weight: e.g. clipping 0.02 alone gives 0.4, RMS 58.0 alone gives 1.0, peak -0.2 alone gives 0.70.

frozen_consequences: The cap-hit floor dominates the flag floor (0.85 beats 0.75) because it is evaluated after it.

The natural-stop clamp is evaluated LAST and is unconditional over the flag floor: a repetition_flag=True record that stopped naturally (EOS, no cap) is clamped to 0.55. This is a deliberate consequence of the frozen rule order from the pre-registration text ('natural stop reduces suspicion' applied last).

Contradictory instrumentation (eos_emitted_effective True AND hit_length_limit_effective True) applies neither the cap floor nor the natural clamp; the base (after the flag floor) stands. The pinned Whisper semantics make this state unreachable; it is recorded so the behavior is defined, not accidental.
Length-anomaly override fires on the same cap-hit-without-EOS condition and is a max(), so it never lowers a larger anomaly.

eligibility_and_status_policy.scoring_record_requirement: In label_free mode every scored candidate requires candidate.asr_output present with status 'ok'. score_candidate raises ValueError('label_free scoring requires AsrOutputFeatures (status ok) for candidate X') otherwise. This keeps premature (pre-J2) selection runs impossible rather than silently ranking on duration alone.
eligibility_and_status_policy.failed_status_policy: A record with status 'failed' is NOT usable: prepare_candidate_pool rejects the candidate with reason code 'scoring_failed' (never scored, never zero-filled, and the reason is reported in pool.rejection_reason_counts).
eligibility_and_status_policy.missing_record_policy: A candidate with NO asr_output is not rejected at eligibility (absence of a record is a distinct fact from a failed decode); it instead fails loudly in score_candidate with the ValueError above, so an integration bug after the scoring run surfaces as an explicit error rather than a silently smaller pool.
eligibility_and_status_policy.ground_truth_prohibition: score_candidate raises ValueError in label_free mode when candidate.asr (ground-truth-derived AsrFailureFeatures) is present, even if a valid asr_output also exists.

prohibited_acquisition_signals: reference transcript text; reference word count; ground-truth WER/CER/S/D/I; transcript-derived language ratios; transcript-derived word-count eligibility; information from the 47-speaker final reserve; official MUCS test data
missing_feature_policy: unavailable -> None; never zero; weights renormalize
failed_status_policy: scoring_failed rejects; never counted as usable

selection_report_keys.formula_version: 'hinglish.labelfree.v1' in label_free mode, None in oracle mode.
selection_report_keys.label_free_component_availability: In label_free mode: {component: {available_count, eligible_count}} over the eligible pool (the rejected failed records are not part of eligible_count). None in oracle mode.

reporting_contract.safe_manifest_columns: UNCHANGED (SAFE_MANIFEST_COLUMNS byte-for-byte). Optional numeric columns carrying None (ratio/count/wer in label-free outputs) are written as empty strings; the writer never emits NaN or None strings.
reporting_contract.allowed_record_shape: AsrOutputFeatures carries numbers and booleans only: status, audio_duration_sec, inference_runtime_sec, generated_token_count, eos_emitted_effective, hit_length_limit_effective, max_consecutive_repeated_tokens, repeated_token_fraction, repetition_flag, mean_logprob, min_logprob, entropy_mean. No decoded_text_length_words or any generated-text property except decoded-text-derived TOKEN repetition statistics. Decoded text stays private in the J2 run witness. entropy_mean is recorded but deliberately unused (weight 0) in this frozen formula.

frozen_interpretations_and_deviations_no: Length-anomaly phase: the pre-registration text read 'anomaly = 0 outside band, else linear from 0 at band edge to 1.0 at lo/hi +- 50%'; the ramp endpoints (0.5*lo, 1.5*hi) lie outside the band, so the only coherent reading is anomaly 0 INSIDE the band with the linear ramp OUTSIDE the band. The frozen implementation states this explicitly: in-band -> 0.0, out-of-band -> linear ramp from 0 at the edge to 1.0 at 0.5*lo / 1.5*hi.

The token-rate denominator is the manifest candidate duration (candidate.duration_sec, guaranteed present in label_free mode); the J2 record's audio_duration_sec is informational in v1 so runs can be cross-checked.

Partial sub-inputs are never averaged into a component: repetition requires both repetition statistics; confidence requires both logprob channels. Whole components missing -> component None -> weight renormalization.

The audio-quality inputs had no carrier field in the pre-registration CandidateRecord sketch; frozen as three new defaulted CandidateRecord fields (audio_peak_dbfs, audio_clipping_fraction, audio_mean_rms_dbfs), all tolerating None so every existing construction site is unchanged.

The pre-J2 CLI 'duration_fit-only prerun' listed in the original spec was rejected by the recorded decision: label_free scoring requires an AsrOutputFeatures record with status 'ok' on every scored candidate, so premature label_free CLI runs fail loudly with 'label_free scoring requires AsrOutputFeatures (status ok) for candidate X'.
privacy: no transcript or reference text; no audio; no predictions; identifier prefixes, numbers, booleans, and formula constants only
